Acbric quick start — 0.3.5.1

1. Fully extract and open Acbric.exe. Keep the EXE with the rest of the folder.
2. On first use, confirm the Steam game found automatically and select Use this game. Choose its folder manually if needed.
3. Select Start game. Use the same EXE next time; no repeated setup is needed.
4. Open MOD folder: add Java .jar MODs or native folders directly containing info.json. The API is included; do not duplicate it.
5. Restart after changing Java MODs. Saves and MODs come directly from your original game: select Sync now
   to detect those folders - nothing is copied and only one copy exists. Use Settings -> Environment
   isolation when this instance should keep its own copies instead.

Choose Chinese/English at the top right. Settings can change the game location, install a local update ZIP or restore the previous framework. Close the game first. Do not extract updates over an old folder.
For help: Help → Export diagnostics. Send the resulting ZIP yourself; saves are excluded and nothing is uploaded automatically.
Existing save/update protections remain. Do not delete broken configuration or backups to bypass checks.

First upgrade from dev.32 or earlier: extract the new package elsewhere, use its advanced/Update Acbric.cmd and select the original folder and new ZIP. Later updates use the EXE.
Default saves/settings: instances/default/userdata. MODs: mods beside the EXE. Create an Acbric.exe shortcut for desktop access.
Full guide: docs/INSTALLER.md. 中文：使用说明.txt
